svg.title: The guild hall: a team account for repos
svg.desc: Pixel art of a medieval guild hall at night, lit by candles and torches. Left, a quest board titled Issues full of sticky notes, with an AI agent robot reading it. A shop window labelled Pages. In the middle a castle gate with a portcullis labelled Checks, guarded by a robot with a check-mark shield. Right, a round vault door labelled Secrets. In front, four people at a round table with role badges: owner, design, build, guest, and a second AI agent robot bringing a pull request envelope.
